qualification-identifiers:
Qualification identifier capture settings (project: qualification; scope: identifier format for the capture CLI integration). Identifiers are opaque strings: trim surrounding whitespace only, preserving leading zeros and case. Supplied by issue trial-n8t (integration qualification, excluded from adoption scores).

```json
{"project": "qualification", "identifiers": {"kind": "opaque-string", "trim": true}, "examples": ["000417", "AC-019"]}
```
